title: v2.11.0 — Rules of Engagement
body:
Cleaner shared play and a readable news feed:
- Shared board drawings are now moderated — prohibited symbols and slurs are blocked before your opponent sees them
- A blocked mark turns red for you with a quick heads-up
- New option to hide your opponent's shared marks entirely — Options → Online
- The News card now lists every update: expandable, scrollable, with an unread badge

title: v2.10.0 — Battle Station
body:
The in-game screen joins the Command Rail:
- Board plate, player strips, and right rail fully redesigned
- Share your board drawings with your opponent — flip SHARE in SIGNALS
- Quick chat: pick a line and your queen says it on their board
- Opening names show live in the shot log
- Auto-queen toggle for instant promotions (the skill check still fires)
- Black pieces wear a rim light — readable on every square
- Games with no moves played now abort: no winners, no losers

title: v2.9.0 — Command Rail
body:
The main menu got rebuilt end to end:
- New left nav rail with a sliding crosshair
- Revolver-cylinder time picker — click the center pin for a random time control
- Right rail with your profile, recent matches, and this news feed
- Fresh gunmetal sounds throughout
- The menu shootout now spills out from under the rails
